notes: The first paragraph asks how to lift the three Sylow 2-subgroups and says they do not lift, referring to a nonsplit local extension and the absence of an order-two lift normalizing L_0. The plural extensions locales followed by singular n’est scindée, and the literal Et bien, are preserved. The next paragraph declines to give presentations of S Gamma and S E and instead gives two inner-action formulas. In (15), both dotted rho symbols and the intervening sigma are individually visible on the full-formula crop; no reading was supplied merely by analogy with (16). The criterion afterward uses undotted rho in its prose and displayed conditions, as written. Formula (17) gives the cyclic relations among g_0,g_1,g_infinity, and the final formula really ends in rho^{-1}(g_0), confirmed on its crop. Struck-text doubt not listed in MARKS: C’s soi is resolved to the unfinished word soi; its s, o and dotted i remain visible beneath the cancellation, with no following ent. The only remaining C doubt is the overworked tuple sigma. No independent algebraic, group-theoretic or local-extension proof check was performed.

The independent audit changes only the unresolved second tuple coordinate to sigma/tau. Both complete conjugation formulas retain their narrow p coordinates, dotted conjugating symbols and visible index order. The canceled ending is literally soi, with no terminal t. The shorthand after revient au has two horizontal strokes and no tau stem. No new mathematical proof check occurred.
